rationale: Adjudicate non-AI. The source identifies Spring.NET as an open-source enterprise .NET application framework. Its official project README inventories an IoC container, AOP, dependency injection, transaction management, ADO.NET and related conventional framework components; this is substantive functional evidence, not keyword absence alone. No credible conflicting AI evidence was presented. Labeler's weak/forced flag was overly cautious relative to the detailed inventory; retain that the exact source-record version is unspecified.
